pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing because load and operational data across systems do not line up.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: Establish a fixed-fee Phase 1 engagement with milestone payments tied to measurable outcomes.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'll give you a fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: Return to 5-day DSO freeing $1.4M in working capital and eliminate the need for 4 new dispatcher hires saving $320k.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time means we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k in fully-loaded comp. And a return to five-day DSO from where we are now frees up about $1.4M in working capital

risks_unknowns.statement: Stakeholders disagree on the total budget cap for the Phase 1 consulting engagement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Rita, the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap... Rita, that's not what we discussed. We discussed a six-month Phase 1 in the $250 to $400 range
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: CFO Rita mandates a strict $300,000 budget cap, whereas VP of Operations Sarah understood Phase 1 to be budgeted between $250,000 and $400,000.

pain_points.statement: The custom Rails dispatch tool (Routemaster) is 7 years old with severe technical debt, making feature delivery slow and fragile.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile. Every change takes three times as long as it should.

desired_state.statement: Disagreement over whether to replace Routemaster with a SaaS platform or build an overlay workflow fix.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem... We could be live on it in nine months... $600k in year one
desired_state.contradiction_note: CTO Marcus advocates replacing Routemaster with a $600k/year SaaS platform, whereas VP of Operations Sarah advocates fixing workflows incrementally within current budget constraints.

success_criteria.statement: Ensure 60-70% of Phase 1 workflow logic and integrations remain portable if Routemaster is replaced later.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Two previous internal projects attempting to fix the dispatch-invoicing technical workflows ended in failure.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers perform redundant manual data entries between Routemaster and Salesforce, while drivers dislike the mobile app.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce, drivers hate the mobile app

desired_state.statement: Streamline dispatcher workflows to eliminate double-entry and improve load processing speed.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fix three specific operational pain points — dispatcher double-entry, the driver app, and invoicing

success_criteria.statement: Achieve a 30% reduction in dispatch processing time per load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: Sarah and I talked about a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: Uncertainty surrounding driver app updates and integration requirements for the November 15 federal ELD compliance mandate.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: The ELD compliance deadline in November is real. The federal mandate update changes how we have to log driver hours and report them.

pain_points.statement: Rapid growth via acquisitions in 2024 left core operational technology integrations incomplete.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Northwind grew 40% in 2024 by acquiring two smaller brokerages. Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: Disagreement on the Phase 1 pilot release timeline between end of Q3 and Q4.
desired_state.source_excerpt: We have a Q3 pilot commitment... Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3. I think Q4 is more realistic
desired_state.contradiction_note: CFO Rita and VP Sarah mandate a Q3 end-of-quarter pilot launch to prevent budget reallocation, while CTO Marcus insists Q4 is a realistic timeframe for proper delivery.

success_criteria.statement: Deploy a production pilot by September 30 (end of Q3) to retain allocated executive funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

risks_unknowns.statement: Executive trust risk caused by CFO's negative past experience with an outside consulting firm in 2023.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Skeptical of consulting engagements; got burned by a previous vendor in 2023.
